item.title: Brighton mother suing Lyft, says teen daughter was driven to sexual predator
item.description: A Livingston County mother has filed a lawsuit against rideshare company Lyft, alleging one of their drivers transported her 14-year-old daughter to a sexual predator who assaulted her.

item.title: 'The signs were there': Na'Ziyah Harris' family demands further accountability in her murder case
item.description: Jarvis Butts must serve 35 to 60 years in prison after pleading guilty to killing Na'Ziyah Harris. He also pleaded guilty to five other cases of sexual assault.

item.title: MSP issues Endangered Missing Advisory for Wayne County man
item.description: Michigan State Police are asking for help with finding a missing man who is diabetic and could have onset Alzheimer’s or dementia.
